question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior be deferred to an external ClawHub plugin?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the solution changes plugin ranking semantics, persistent FTS index behavior, config/default surface, and fallback policy for existing memory-lancedb users.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add a memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS index creation, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Defer to ClawHub or an external plugin
options.body: Close or retitle this after maintainers decide advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank features should be owned outside the official plugin source.

options.title: Keep memory-lancedb vector-only
options.body: Document memory-lancedb as a vector backend while memory-core/QMD own hybrid retrieval, avoiding a new config and indexing surface.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add a memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS index creation, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-source and prior review-context signal for memory-lancedb follow-up.
